headline_seed: Ratko Mladić, the ‘Butcher of Bosnia’, given hero’s funeral in Serbia - The Guardian
draft_text:
Ratko Mladić, convicted of genocide for the 1995 Srebrenica massacre of ~8,000 Bosniak men and boys, was buried in Belgrade Monday with military honors. Thousands attended. BBC News and CNN report the EU denounced the "glorification."

And that's the mews.
